atr_definition: Use the unchanged engine atr: preceding 14 closed 15m high-low ranges averaged after shift(1); not Wilder true-range ATR.
closed_entry_filters: close>open, close>previous_close, price-event=1 and stress-cost-feasible=1; shared ATR validity still applies.

decision_time_cost_screen.admission: All finite with C>0,a>0,R>0,STOP>0; require R>Kflat and Ntarget>0. Strict comparisons, no fitted multiplier or relaxed costs.
decision_time_cost_screen.boundary: Decision-time hypothetical next open equals C only for this screen. Actual next-open gaps/fills/stop-target remain the unchanged shared engine; the screen neither predicts a target hit nor guarantees actual profitable fills.
decision_time_cost_screen.inputs: C=current closed decision close; a=existing lagged engine atr; R=frozen macro H-L. f=25/10000, s=15/10000; no future open.

diagnostic_integration_boundary: Use a separately source-bound observational hook in the isolated research child to capture the unchanged backtest execution. It must not mutate simulator locals, order or values. Prove identical metrics and retained backtest AST-source hash on hand fixtures before producer admission. No hook capability or full fill-trace coverage is claimed at preregistration; if unavailable, block that producer gate rather than claim an audit.
engineering_choices: 6 preceding 4h bars, 6h first-touch window and 8x15m trigger window are frozen engineering horizons before implementation/outcomes; not universal market laws or a guaranteed edge.
execution: Unchanged next-open, stop-first on ambiguous stop/target, 1.5 atr/2R/64-bar exits.
executor: Isolated Laptop2 research; Laptop1 remains sole Paper writer; failover disabled.
expiry: WAIT_RETEST expires strictly after tau+6h so an hour closing exactly at the deadline can qualify; READY expires after retest_confirmation+8 completed 15m steps. Consumed/expired/invalidated identities cannot reopen.

feature_visibility.lagged_macro_retest_active: Equals 1 only for a valid READY retest setup stored after the previous 15m decision; WAIT_RETEST is not entry-active.
feature_visibility.macro_retest_close_breakout_event: Current closed 15m first eligible fresh price crossing of K; independent of cost/body/context admission and consumes the identity.
feature_visibility.macro_retest_stress_cost_feasible: Boolean decision-time cost screen using current closed C, previous-bar-derived a and lagged frozen macro R; same stress parameters for both simulation profiles.

first_touch: First eligible completed 1h with low<=H. If close>H and close>open and low>L, arm K=that 1h high; otherwise consume/disarm this macro identity. Do not wait for a more favorable subsequent touch.
higher_timeframe_filters: Unchanged completed/asof and one-decision-lagged h4_up=1, h1_vol_ok=1.
input_validation: Complete aligned UTC15m/1h/4h grids with unique ordered timestamps, finite positive OHLC, consistent high/low and nonnegative volume. Missing/partial/overlapping higher-timeframe bars never arm state; malformed canonical input fails closed.
macro_event: At newly closed 4h k, freeze H=max(high[k-6:k]) and L=min(low[k-6:k]); R=H-L>0. Accept a bullish close[k]>open[k] and close[k]>H. The current k bar is excluded from its band.
macro_identity: The accepted 4h candle open timestamp/index plus frozen prior-band endpoints; one first retest and one price event per macro identity.
name: closed_4h_break_first_1h_retest_cost_feasible_15m_continuation
next_gate: Implement one additive helper/proposal and approved-field extension; verify source/causal/compatibility/observational hooks. Only then freeze one fresh source/data/ledger-bound producer. Do not replay v8/v9 or retune observed later folds.
price_event_consumption: Consume the macro identity at its first eligible price event even if separate body, regime, ATR or cost admission gates reject entry; never delay or reactivate it.
price_trigger: Using only the setup stored after t-1, emit the first fresh close[t]>K with close[t-1]<=K. Intrabar high is insufficient.
raw_timestamp_meaning: canonical candle open UTC; availability is open + interval
retest_eligibility: Only a completed 1h candle whose OPEN is at/after macro CLOSE tau and whose CLOSE is >tau and <=tau+6h. No candle overlapping the displacement hour counts.
roundoff_policy: Representation only; no economic tolerance or optimized margin.
same_close_processing_order: Evaluate previous-decision stored macro/armed setup: expiry and current closed 15m invalidation first, then a fresh current price event.
Process each newly completed eligible 1h bar for the surviving previous macro; first touch is decisive. The resulting retest setup becomes future state only.
Process the newly completed 4h breakout last. A newly accepted macro replaces/disarms an old pending macro for future decisions; a nonaccepted 4h bar does not create or replace a macro.
source_gate_requirements: every-prefix and future-tail invariance across all three timeframes
cost math at both profiles and invalid/gap/ATR values
all 94 prior contracts/121 mechanisms/configs/order and exact shared risk source
source-bound observational trace preserves hand-fixture fills and aggregate outputs
exact-source full hosted and native source gates with actual owned exit
timing_example: Macro closes 04:00. Earliest fully later retest is 04:00..05:00, known 05:00 after that decision. Earliest price decision is the 05:00..05:15 candle close. Fill is next bar OPEN at 05:15 (later bar index, same boundary UTC); never at an earlier bar. This preserves the shared zero-boundary modeled next-open convention and makes no live latency claim.
whole_interval_invalidation: From the first fully subsequent closed 15m bar onward, any low<=L or close<=H consumes/disarms the macro before a same-bar entry or retest acceptance. Preserve strict hold behavior through waiting/retest/trigger states.
